text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, a race she 
bet everything on. Yet the wall of the 
world was mercilessly high—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, their challenge on the world stage 
came to an end. The public was confronted 
with the limits of Japanese Umamusume, 
dispiritedly dismissing the dream as mere 
fantasy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, none of the girls aiming for the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe had given up on 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All their accumulated efforts, the chance 
almost within reach... After coming this 
far, their passion wasn't about to die 
out. The challenge was far from over—
